title: CVE-2020-5847 — Unraid Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

title: CVE-2019-16759 — vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

title: CVE-2019-5544 — VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
summary: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

title: CVE-2020-3992 — VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
summary: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

title: CVE-2020-3950 — VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

title: CVE-2021-21972 — VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

title: CVE-2026-124747 — A flaw was found in BusyBox
summary: A flaw was found in BusyBox. When resuming a download over File Transfer Protocol (FTP), the wget utility fails to verify that the resume offset does not exceed the file size reported by the server, resulting in an integer calculation error. A malicious FTP server or an on-path network attacker can exploit this issue by returning crafted file size metadata, triggering a heap-based buffer overflow with attacker-controlled data. Successful exploitation may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code or crash the application, resulting in a denial of service (DoS).

summary:
Summary


Cloudflare tokio-quiche was found to contain an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in its HTTP/3 DATAGRAM handling. For every previously unseen flow identifier (quarter stream ID) received in a DATAGRAM frame, tokio-quiche creates and retains new, per-flow state. A remote peer can send DATAGRAMs with many distinct identifiers, causing the per-connection flow map and associated channel state to grow without bound.

title: CVE-2026-111262 — The Jakarta Security LDAP identity store does not neutralize special characters in the caller name before using it in directory queries
summary: The Jakarta Security LDAP identity store does not neutralize special characters in the caller name before using it in directory queries. A remote unauthenticated attacker can alter the queries to enumerate accounts, infer directory attribute values, or influence which directory entry the login is validated against. Only applications using the LDAP identity store are affected. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111263 — Authentication configured for an EJB JAX-WS endpoint in the TomEE deployment descriptor is not enforced when the endpoint is published within an exist
summary: Authentication configured for an EJB JAX-WS endpoint in the TomEE deployment descriptor is not enforced when the endpoint is published within an existing web application. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the web service operations, unless the application protects the endpoint with its own web.xml security constraints or EJB method permissions. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111264 — The security constraint generated for EJB JAX-WS endpoints with configured authentication protects only some HTTP methods
summary: The security constraint generated for EJB JAX-WS endpoints with configured authentication protects only some HTTP methods. A remote unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication by sending requests with another HTTP method. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-114359 — Eclipse Kura downloads deployment packages (DPs) from a remote URL without any limit on the size of the data it receives
summary: Eclipse Kura downloads deployment packages (DPs) from a remote URL without any limit on the size of the data it receives. A malicious or compromised HTTP(S) server, or an attacker able to tamper with a plain-HTTP download, can stream an arbitrarily large (or endless) response. Kura writes the response to local storage until the filesystem is full. On gateways the temporary directory is often a RAM-backed tmpfs, so this can also exhaust memory. The result is denial of service of the device: failed configuration persistence, failed logging and possible crashes of the framework or other services.

title: CVE-2026-121885 — A flaw was found in Podman
summary: A flaw was found in Podman. An attacker can trigger a Denial of Service (DoS) by supplying a container image containing crafted metadata labels. Podman's auto-update mechanism improperly trusts these image labels to determine which system services to restart. If a user runs the malicious container and auto-update processes it, arbitrary system services are restarted with the user's privileges, potentially allowing an attacker to shut down the host system when Podman runs with administrative privileges.

title: CVE-2026-123082 — Docker Desktop before version 4
summary: Docker Desktop before version 4.94.0 could write the signed-in user's Docker Hub access token (a JWT) in cleartext to application logs and diagnostics bundles. IPC payloads that were bare JSON strings or arrays were not redacted before logging, and a Docker Desktop component logged the token when it requested it from the backend. An attacker with read access to these files could obtain the token and use it to read and modify the user's Docker Hub data as that user while the token remains valid. Docker Desktop 4.94.0 redacts these payloads. The fix does not rewrite logs written by earlier versi

title: CVE-2026-86532 — The bundled JAAS login modules leak whether a username exists and compare credentials in a non-constant-time manner
summary: The bundled JAAS login modules leak whether a username exists and compare credentials in a non-constant-time manner. A remote unauthenticated attacker can enumerate valid accounts and may infer credential material through timing analysis. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-86811 — The stateful session bean passivation mechanism derives the on-disk file name from a client-supplied identifier without validating it
summary: The stateful session bean passivation mechanism derives the on-disk file name from a client-supplied identifier without validating it. A remote attacker with access to the remote EJB service can cause session state to be read from or written to files outside the passivation directory. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-87755 — Stateful session bean identifiers are not generated from a cryptographically secure random source
summary: Stateful session bean identifiers are not generated from a cryptographically secure random source. A remote attacker with access to the EJB remote endpoint who holds one valid identifier can derive those of other clients' sessions and invoke methods on their beans, exposing or modifying other users' session state. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-87756 — The internal system EJBs used for remote deployment and configuration did not enforce their administrative role check when the server ran with the def
summary: The internal system EJBs used for remote deployment and configuration did not enforce their administrative role check when the server ran with the default profile. A remote unauthenticated attacker able to reach the remote EJB endpoint could deploy arbitrary applications and execute code. Only installations that enabled the system applications and a remote EJB endpoint are exposed. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-105425 — OS command injection in Ivanti Sentry before versions 11
summary: OS command injection in Ivanti Sentry before versions 11.0.0, 10.8.3, and 10.7.4 as well as in Ivanti EPMM before versions 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to achieve remote code execution.

title: CVE-2026-105426 — Improper input validation in Ivanti EPMM before version 12
summary: Improper input validation in Ivanti EPMM before version 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to set arbitrary Linux kernel parameters as root.

title: CVE-2026-105427 — Improper input validation in Ivanti EPMM before version 12
summary: Improper input validation in Ivanti EPMM before version 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to permanently disable all Apache HTTPS services resulting in denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-105669 — Argument injection in Ivanti Sentry before version 11
summary: Argument injection in Ivanti Sentry before version 11.0, 10.8.3, and 10.7.4 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to execute arbitrary on-disk binaries.

title: CVE-2026-105813 — Cleartext storage of sensitive information in Ivanti UWM before version 2026
summary: Cleartext storage of sensitive information in Ivanti UWM before version 2026.4 allows a local authenticated attacker to retrieve another local user's session token.

title: CVE-2026-107404 — Argument injection in Ivanti EPMM before version 12
summary: Argument injection in Ivanti EPMM before version 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to delete arbitrary files on disk.

title: CVE-2026-108186 — Improper Input Validation in Zoom Workplace for Windows may allow an unauthenticated user to conduct an escalation of privilege via network access
summary: Improper Input Validation in Zoom Workplace for Windows may allow an unauthenticated user to conduct an escalation of privilege via network access.

title: CVE-2026-108187 — Origin Validation Error in Zoom Workplace for Windows may allow an unauthenticated user to conduct an escalation of privilege via network access
summary: Origin Validation Error in Zoom Workplace for Windows may allow an unauthenticated user to conduct an escalation of privilege via network access.

title: CVE-2026-111239 — The optional SSH administration service grants full access to the administration shell to every user that authenticates against its configured login d
summary: The optional SSH administration service grants full access to the administration shell to every user that authenticates against its configured login domain, without checking for an administrative role. An attacker holding the credentials of any user in that domain, including a low-privileged application user, can execute arbitrary code as the server process. Users are recommended to disable the SSH administration service, or to block network access to it from untrusted clients and restrict its login domain to administrative users.

title: CVE-2026-111240 — The JDBC based JAAS login module accepts a login without a password for accounts whose stored password is NULL
summary: The JDBC based JAAS login module accepts a login without a password for accounts whose stored password is NULL. A remote attacker who knows the user name of such an account can authenticate as that user and obtain its roles. Only deployments using this login module with NULL passwords in the user table are affected. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111241 — When a non-default stateful session bean passivation strategy is configured, passivated bean state is written to predictably named files in the shared
summary: When a non-default stateful session bean passivation strategy is configured, passivated bean state is written to predictably named files in the shared system temporary directory, reusing files that already exist there, and is deserialized on activation. A local attacker who can write to that directory can read passivated session state or supply data that the server deserializes, potentially leading to code execution as the server process. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111242 — When MicroProfile JWT authentication is used for servlets that declare a run-as identity, the security state established for a request is not always c
summary: When MicroProfile JWT authentication is used for servlets that declare a run-as identity, the security state established for a request is not always cleared from the processing thread when the request does not complete normally. A remote attacker holding a valid token can cause later, unrelated requests served by the same thread to invoke enterprise beans with the elevated run-as identity. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111243 — A negative MicroProfile JWT clock skew setting is not rejected and disables validation of the token expiration and other time-based claims
summary: A negative MicroProfile JWT clock skew setting is not rejected and disables validation of the token expiration and other time-based claims. In such configurations, an attacker in possession of an expired token can still authenticate with it. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111244 — When MicroProfile JWT role-based access control is used, the access constraints of JAX-RS resources are not always enforced as declared: resources tha
summary: When MicroProfile JWT role-based access control is used, the access constraints of JAX-RS resources are not always enforced as declared: resources that declare an empty set of allowed roles are accessible to every caller, resource classes that inherit the same method from a common superclass share their constraints, and class-level constraints declared on a superclass are ignored. A remote attacker can invoke resources that should be denied to them, in some configurations without authentication. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111245 — After a successful WS-Security UsernameToken authentication, the caller identity stays associated with the worker thread once the request completes wh
summary: After a successful WS-Security UsernameToken authentication, the caller identity stays associated with the worker thread once the request completes when web services are served by the standalone OpenEJB HTTP server. A remote unauthenticated attacker whose request is later processed on the same thread can invoke protected EJB methods with the identity of a previously authenticated user. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111246 — The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server does not isolate HTTP sessions between web applications
summary: The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server does not isolate HTTP sessions between web applications. A remote attacker can use a session established in one web application in another one, which then trusts session state set by the first application. Only deployments hosting several web applications on the embedded HTTP server are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

title: CVE-2026-111247 — When resolving security roles of a realm-authenticated caller, the caller's user name is also treated as a role name in addition to the roles assigned
summary: When resolving security roles of a realm-authenticated caller, the caller's user name is also treated as a role name in addition to the roles assigned by the realm. An authenticated attacker who can obtain an account whose user name equals a role name, for example through self-registration, is granted that role wherever authorization is evaluated through the Jakarta Authorization policy. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111248 — The Jakarta Security identity store backed by the Tomcat user database compares the supplied password with the stored value as plain text and ignores
summary: The Jakarta Security identity store backed by the Tomcat user database compares the supplied password with the stored value as plain text and ignores the configured credential handler. When digested passwords are stored, an attacker who obtained a stored digest, for example from a leaked users file or backup, can authenticate with the digest instead of the password. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111249 — The development-time LiveReload support listens on all network interfaces without authentication and accepts websocket connections from any origin
summary: The development-time LiveReload support listens on all network interfaces without authentication and accepts websocket connections from any origin. A network attacker, or a web page visited by the developer, can observe the names of changed files in the watched folder and the server version, and reach the deployed applications through the additional port. This only affects LiveReload enabled in the embedded Maven plugin. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111250 — The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server reports every request as authenticated when an application requests authentication programmatically
summary: The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server reports every request as authenticated when an application requests authentication programmatically. A remote unauthenticated attacker can access functionality protected this way. Only applications served by the embedded HTTP server that rely on programmatic authentication are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

title: CVE-2026-111251 — The admin service of the standalone OpenEJB server accepts stop requests without any authentication
summary: The admin service of the standalone OpenEJB server accepts stop requests without any authentication. Any local user or process able to connect to the admin port can stop the server, leading to denial of service; the admin service is enabled by default in the standalone server and bound to the loopback interface. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111256 — When JAX-WS or JAX-RS endpoints are published by the embedded OpenEJB HTTP server rather than Tomcat, some configured authentication methods are silen
summary: When JAX-WS or JAX-RS endpoints are published by the embedded OpenEJB HTTP server rather than Tomcat, some configured authentication methods are silently ignored and the endpoint is published without authentication. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the exposed operations without credentials. Only deployments that use the embedded HTTP server and rely on such an authentication method are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

title: CVE-2026-111257 — With the default configuration and no users defined in the default user database, TomEE silently adds an administrative user with a well-known passwor
summary: With the default configuration and no users defined in the default user database, TomEE silently adds an administrative user with a well-known password at startup. A remote attacker can use these credentials to authenticate to web applications that use the default realm and grant access to any authenticated user or to the TomEE administrative role. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111258 — The optional request routing feature forwards requests to their configured destination without applying the security constraints of that destination o
summary: The optional request routing feature forwards requests to their configured destination without applying the security constraints of that destination or the protection of the web application's private directories. If a route copies client-controlled parts of the request path into its destination, a remote attacker can reach protected resources or read application configuration and class files. Only installations with such a routing configuration are affected. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111259 — The embedded server generates HTTP session identifiers with a non-cryptographic random number generator by default
summary: The embedded server generates HTTP session identifiers with a non-cryptographic random number generator by default. A remote attacker who observes a session identifier can predict the identifiers issued to other users and hijack their sessions, if the application relies on HTTP sessions for authentication. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111260 — The Jakarta Security OpenID Connect authentication mechanism generates the state and nonce values with a non-cryptographic random number generator and
summary: The Jakarta Security OpenID Connect authentication mechanism generates the state and nonce values with a non-cryptographic random number generator and insufficient entropy. A remote attacker who predicts these values can forge an authentication callback that logs a victim into the attacker's account, and the replay protection for ID tokens is weakened. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-111261 — The Jakarta Security LDAP identity store accepts an empty password as valid if the directory server allows unauthenticated binds, which some directory
summary: The Jakarta Security LDAP identity store accepts an empty password as valid if the directory server allows unauthenticated binds, which some directory servers do by default. A remote attacker can then authenticate as any existing user without knowing the password. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-112191 — In Eclipse Kura versions 5
summary: In Eclipse Kura versions 5.4.0 through 5.6.2, the Identity REST APIs (identity/v1, and identity/v2 since 5.5.0, provided by org.eclipse.kura.rest.identity.provider) do not check identity and permission management requests against the permissions of the requesting identity. An authenticated identity holding the rest.identity permission, but not kura.admin, can assign any permission to any identity, including kura.admin to itself. It can also change the password of, or delete, identities holding more privileges than its own, including administrators, and create or delete permissions. This allows

title: CVE-2026-11315 — A out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the dr_mp3 drmp3_init_internal functionality of dr_libs (version(s): 0
summary: A out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the dr_mp3 drmp3_init_internal functionality of dr_libs (version(s): 0.7.3). A specially crafted .mp3 file can lead to an out-of-bounds read. An attacker can provide a malicious file to trigger this vulnerability.

title: CVE-2026-11316 — A out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the dr_wav drwav__read_cue_to_metadata_obj functionality of dr_libs (version(s): 0
summary: A out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the dr_wav drwav__read_cue_to_metadata_obj functionality of dr_libs (version(s): 0.14.5). A specially crafted .wav file can lead to an out-of-bounds write. An attacker can provide a malicious file to trigger this vulnerability.

title: CVE-2026-121653 — SQL injection in the Core of Ivanti Endpoint Manager before version 2024 SU8 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution
summary: SQL injection in the Core of Ivanti Endpoint Manager before version 2024 SU8 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

title: CVE-2026-121683 — Missing authentication in Ivanti Cloud Services Application version 5
summary: Missing authentication in Ivanti Cloud Services Application version 5.0.8 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to add and delete arbitrary trusted EPM Core certificate entries.

title: CVE-2026-123179 — An insecure default initialization of resource in the Tomcat shutdown listener of Ivanti Sentry before versions 11
summary: An insecure default initialization of resource in the Tomcat shutdown listener of Ivanti Sentry before versions 11.0, 10.8.3, and 10.7.4 allows a local authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-123181 — A path traversal vulnerability in Ivanti Sentry before versions 11
summary: A path traversal vulnerability in Ivanti Sentry before versions 11.0, 10.8.3, and 10.7.4 allows a remote authenticated attacker with administrative privileges to create arbitrary directories and files with root privileges.

title: CVE-2026-124036 — Missing authorization checks in the visual alert feature of FlockOS, Flock's hosted public safety platform, prior to 2026-09-28, allowed an authentica
summary: Missing authorization checks in the visual alert feature of FlockOS, Flock's hosted public safety platform, prior to 2026-09-28, allowed an authenticated user with permission to manage saved searches in their own organization to read, modify or delete another organization's saved-search alerts and change their recipients, given the alert's identifier, and to create alerts attributed to another organization. Flock remediated the issue in the hosted service on 2026-09-28; no customer action is required.

title: CVE-2026-124037 — An information exposure flaw in the public access-list sign-up feature of the Flock Safety Platform, present from 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-22, allowed a
summary: An information exposure flaw in the public access-list sign-up feature of the Flock Safety Platform, present from 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-22, allowed a remote, unauthenticated attacker who had a community's public sign-up link and a registered vehicle's license plate to retrieve that registrant's name, email address, home address and approval status. Each lookup required solving a CAPTCHA. No license plate reader detections, images or video were exposed. Flock remediated the issue in the hosted service on 2026-10-22; no customer action is required.

title: CVE-2026-124038 — An uncontrolled XML entity expansion vulnerability in the Flock Installer app for Android before version 2
summary: An uncontrolled XML entity expansion vulnerability in the Flock Installer app for Android before version 2.35.0 allows an attacker who has a valid technician account and controls or impersonates the camera being set up to crash the app, on devices running Android 10, 11 or 12, by returning a camera configuration response that contains nested XML entity declarations. The vulnerability does not allow the attacker to read or change data on the device, and no customer license plate, video or location data is exposed. Android 13 and later reject the response. The issue is fixed in version 2.35.0; u

title: CVE-2026-125747 — ZenTao PMS through 22
summary: ZenTao PMS through 22.7 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability in module/build/control.php that allows authenticated users to modify builds in projects they do not belong to. Attackers holding build privileges in any project can supply sequential buildID values to delete, edit, or relink stories and bugs on builds in foreign or private projects.

title: CVE-2026-125748 — Parabol before 15
summary: Parabol before 15.21.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the addReactjiToReactable GraphQL mutation that allows authenticated users to tamper with reactions on other organizations' content. Attackers can pair their own meetingId with a reactableId of another tenant's reflection, comment, or sequential team prompt response to add or remove their reactions.

title: CVE-2026-125749 — TaxHacker through 0
summary: TaxHacker through 0.8.5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in app/(app)/settings/actions.ts that allows authenticated users to modify other users' data by supplying an arbitrary userId. Attackers can invoke Server Actions like deleteCategoryAction or editFieldAction with a victim's UUID to delete categories, clear transaction assignments, or alter LLM prompts.

title: CVE-2026-125750 — Firekylin through 2
summary: Firekylin through 2.18.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows editor-role users to read administrator-only secrets because the admin API base guard permits all GET actions. Editors can query options.js for TOTP secrets, push credentials, and cloud storage keys, or user.js for other users' app_key/app_secret to publish posts as administrators via admin/post_push.

title: CVE-2026-125751 — Meteroid before 2
summary: Meteroid before 2.2.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the ApiTokensService GetApiTokenById gRPC handler that fails to apply the caller's tenant context. Authenticated users with settings:read permission can supply another tenant's API token ID to obtain its Argon2 secret hash and owning tenant ID.

title: CVE-2026-125752 — Meteroid before 2
summary: Meteroid before 2.2.0 contains a cross-tenant authorization bypass vulnerability in the CouponsService UpdateCouponStatus gRPC handler, whose UPDATE query filters only on coupon id and ignores tenant ID. Authenticated users with catalog:manage or a tenant-scoped API key can supply another tenant's coupon ID to disable, archive, or re-enable that coupon and receive its details.

title: CVE-2026-125753 — ABP Framework 2
summary: ABP Framework 2.9.0 before 10.6.2 and 10.7.0 pre-releases before 10.7.0 contain a path traversal vulnerability in DefaultBlobFilePathCalculator that allows unauthenticated attackers to access files outside the blob container. Attackers can send %5C-encoded backslashes through the Blogging api/blogging/files/{name} endpoint on Windows hosts to read files like appsettings.json containing signing keys and connection strings.

title: CVE-2026-125754 — Dolibarr 20
summary: Dolibarr 20.0.0 through 23.0.4 and 24.x before 24.0.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in api_expensereports.class.php payment endpoints that lets authenticated users access other users' expense report payments. Attackers with only expense report read and create rights can call getAllPayments, getPayments, addPayment, or updatePayment to read, create, or modify payments, falsifying reimbursement state.

title: CVE-2026-125755 — Nodemailer 3
summary: Nodemailer 3.0.0 before 10.4.1 contains an address parsing flaw in addressparser that truncates domains at folding whitespace or comments before a dot, allowing attackers to bypass recipient domain restrictions. Attackers can submit crafted to, cc, bcc or replyTo addresses that pass RFC 5322 domain checks but deliver mail to an attacker-chosen address under the application's sender identity.

title: CVE-2026-125756 — postal-mime before 4
summary: postal-mime before 4.2.1 contains a parser differential vulnerability in its address parser that truncates the domain at folding whitespace or comments preceding a dot. Remote attackers can craft From headers that pass SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment for their own subdomain while PostalMime.parse() reports a spoofed victim sender address.

title: CVE-2026-125757 — mailcow: dockerized before 2026-11 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows domain administrators to execute commands in th
summary: mailcow: dockerized before 2026-11 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows domain administrators to execute commands in the shared rspamd container by storing a malicious domain-wide footer. Attackers can embed a Jinja macro with an os.execute default value, rendered by the rspamd MOO_FOOTER prefilter, to read or inject mail for every tenant and disable filtering.

title: CVE-2026-125758 — Aptabase before commit 61d4c01 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge sign-in links by using t
summary: Aptabase before commit 61d4c01 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge sign-in links by using the publicly known example AUTH_SECRET. Attackers can enumerate registered e-mails via /api/_auth/signin, forge HS256 JWTs redeemed by /api/_auth/continue, impersonate users, export analytics data, and transfer app ownership.

title: CVE-2026-125759 — Nango before 0
summary: Nango before 0.71.3 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL by supplying a crafted task group key to the orchestrator API. Attackers can send a malicious group.key to POST /v1/immediate, which TaskEventsHandler.notify() interpolates into a Postgres NOTIFY statement, running stacked queries against the scheduler database.

title: CVE-2026-18128 — Cleartext transmission of sensitive information in the Agent of Ivanti Endpoint Manager before version 2024 SU8 allows a remote unauthenticated attack
summary: Cleartext transmission of sensitive information in the Agent of Ivanti Endpoint Manager before version 2024 SU8 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to in a MITM position to read and modify HTTP traffic.

title: CVE-2026-86336 — Apache TomEE running on JDK 21 or later skips EJB method authorization checks, allowing callers to invoke EJB methods without the configured access re
summary: Apache TomEE running on JDK 21 or later skips EJB method authorization checks, allowing callers to invoke EJB methods without the configured access restrictions being enforced. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-86531 — The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server does not limit the size of incoming request bodies or of multipart requests, and does not remove the temporary files
summary: The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server does not limit the size of incoming request bodies or of multipart requests, and does not remove the temporary files it creates for multipart parts. A remote unauthenticated attacker can cause excessive memory or disk usage, leading to denial of service. Deployments using the Tomcat connectors are not affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

title: CVE-2026-87758 — The remote EJB client does not verify that the hostname of the server it connects to matches the server's TLS certificate
summary: The remote EJB client does not verify that the hostname of the server it connects to matches the server's TLS certificate. An attacker able to intercept network traffic between an EJB client and server can impersonate the server and read or modify the traffic, including credentials and invocation data. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-97402 — In Eclipse Kura versions 3
summary: In Eclipse Kura versions 3.1.0 to 5.6.2, the iBeacon and Eddystone advertisement decoders wrongly parse the AD-structure length field of an over-the-air BLE advertising payload. Any unauthenticated attacker within BLE radio range can broadcast a two-byte advertising payload that drives the Kura beacon-scanner thread into a tight infinite loop, pinning a CPU core and permanently halting beacon ingestion until the gateway is restarted. To trigger the attack, the iBeacon/Eddystone scanner component should be installed and active. By default the components are not installed or enabled.

title: CVE-2026-97849 — The embedded Derby network service ignores its configured bind address and listens on all network interfaces
summary: The embedded Derby network service ignores its configured bind address and listens on all network interfaces. When the service is enabled, a remote attacker with network access can connect to the database server and read or modify data. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-97867 — The EJBd remote protocol returns datasource connection details, including database credentials, to remote clients that look up a datasource
summary: The EJBd remote protocol returns datasource connection details, including database credentials, to remote clients that look up a datasource. A remote client able to reach the EJBd endpoint can obtain the database credentials and connect to the database directly. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-97870 — When Hessian remoting endpoints are served by the embedded HTTP server, configured authentication and transport security requirements are silently ign
summary: When Hessian remoting endpoints are served by the embedded HTTP server, configured authentication and transport security requirements are silently ignored. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the exposed EJB methods without credentials or over an unencrypted connection. Only deployments that use the embedded HTTP server rather than Tomcat and rely on these settings are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to Hessian endpoints from untrusted clients, or to migrate to another remoting protocol.

title: CVE-2026-97872 — When an EJB is exposed over the optional Hessian protocol inside an existing web application, some configured authentication and transport security se
summary: When an EJB is exposed over the optional Hessian protocol inside an existing web application, some configured authentication and transport security settings are silently not enforced. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the exposed EJB methods. Only deployments using the Hessian module with such settings are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to Hessian endpoints from untrusted clients, or to migrate to another remoting protocol.

title: CVE-2026-97874 — When Hessian remoting is configured with BASIC authentication, the authentication check is not applied to Hessian endpoints of applications deployed u
summary: When Hessian remoting is configured with BASIC authentication, the authentication check is not applied to Hessian endpoints of applications deployed under a non-root context path. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the exposed EJB methods without credentials. Users are recommended to block network access to Hessian endpoints from untrusted clients, or to migrate to another remoting protocol.

title: CVE-2026-97880 — The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server dispatches some requests to REST endpoints configured for HTTP Basic authentication without verifying credentials
summary: The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server dispatches some requests to REST endpoints configured for HTTP Basic authentication without verifying credentials. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke protected resources, bypassing authentication. Only deployments that use the embedded HTTP server with Basic authentication are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

summary: In Eclipse Kura versions 5.4.0 through 5.6.2, the Service Listing V1 REST API read the JSON body of every request into memory, with no limit on its size. summary: rabbitmq-c is a C-language AMQP client library for RabbitMQ. title: CVE-2026-63010 — Group-Office is an enterprise customer relationship management and groupware tool
summary: Group-Office is an enterprise customer relationship management and groupware tool. Prior to versions 6.8.172, 25.0.108, and 26.0.33, a low-privileged user can create manual reminders containing arbitrary HTML/JavaScript and assign them to any other user (including administrators). When the victim's browser polls for pending notifications, the payload renders unsanitized as innerHTML in the ExtJS notification panel, achieving Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to full Account Takeover (ATO) of the victim's session. This issue has been patched in versions 6.8.172, 25.0.108, and 26.0.33.

title: CVE-2026-63651 — LiveDocs is a primary-source-first documentation for AI agents
summary: LiveDocs is a primary-source-first documentation for AI agents. Prior to version 0.7.0, fetch_docs and introspect (kinds openapi/graphql, and resolve_source's docs_url) pass a client-supplied URL straight to URLSession with no scheme or host allowlist, and redirects are followed unconditionally. summary: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in aggregation queries in Neo4j @neo4j/graphql 5.0.0 before 5.12.17 and 7.0.0 before 7.6.8 allows remote attackers to read protected data via GraphQL aggregation queries. title: CVE-2026-97891 — In Eclipse Kura version 5
summary: In Eclipse Kura version 5.0.0 to 5.6.2, the Web Console allocates a new HTTP session for every request to its built-in authentication endpoints (/admin/auth, /admin/login/password, /admin/login/cert) before checking the HTTP method, parsing the request, or validating any submitted credentials, and does not limit how many such sessions can be allocated. An unauthenticated client that sends requests to these endpoints without honoring the returned session cookie can cause the server to allocate an unbounded number of sessions, exhausting the JVM heap and crashing the Kura process.

title: CVE-2026-120212 — Web::Simple versions before 0
summary:
Web::Simple versions before 0.037 for Perl do not escape single quotes in HTML::Tags output.

HTML::Tags and XML::Tags escape a plain string value by replacing only &, ", < and > with entities. A value interpolated into a single-quoted attribute, as in <a href='$value'>, can therefore close the attribute and add new ones, such as an event handler. Double-quoted attributes are not affected.

An attacker who controls a value that an application interpolates into a single-quoted attribute can inject script into the generated page.

title: CVE-2026-126132 — When a message was forwarded inline, edited as new, or had an attachment dragged into a compose window, a specially crafted link attachment (a
summary:
When a message was forwarded inline, edited as new, or had an attachment dragged into a compose window, a specially crafted link attachment (a .desktop file on Linux, or a .url or .lnk file on Windows) was replaced with the content of the file or URL it pointed to when the message was saved or sent. This could disclose local files, or content from the user's network, to the message recipients or to the mail provider.
This bug only affects Thunderbird on Linux and Windows. Other operating systems are unaffected. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 160 and Thunderbird 153.7.

title: CVE-2026-126133 — When a CalDAV or ICS calendar was accessed through an HTTP proxy that requested authentication, Thunderbird could answer the proxy with the calendar s
summary: When a CalDAV or ICS calendar was accessed through an HTTP proxy that requested authentication, Thunderbird could answer the proxy with the calendar server's username and password. This affected both setting up a new calendar and syncing existing calendars, where a saved password could be sent without any user interaction. A malicious or compromised proxy could use this to obtain the calendar credentials, even for calendars served over HTTPS. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 160 and Thunderbird 153.7.

title: CVE-2026-126134 — Thunderbird allowed feed subscriptions to file: URLs that point to a network share
summary:
Thunderbird allowed feed subscriptions to file: URLs that point to a network share. If a user was tricked into subscribing to such a URL, Thunderbird connected to the attacker's server when fetching the feed. Windows then sent the user's NTLM credentials to that server.
This bug only affects Thunderbird on Windows. Other operating systems are unaffected. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 160 and Thunderbird 153.7.

title: CVE-2026-126136 — For Exchange accounts using EWS or Microsoft Graph with OAuth2 authentication, Thunderbird sent the OAuth2 access token to the server even when the co
summary: For Exchange accounts using EWS or Microsoft Graph with OAuth2 authentication, Thunderbird sent the OAuth2 access token to the server even when the configured server URL used unencrypted HTTP. title: CVE-2026-99286 — In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xen-netback: Fix XenBus connection failure cleanup xenvif_get_stats and xenvif_get
summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-netback: Fix XenBus connection failure cleanup

xenvif_get_stats and xenvif_get_ethtool_stats capture vif->num_queues
under rcu_read_lock. We need to unpublish vif->num_queues before
synchronize_net to ensure that readers that come afterwards will not
read a non-zero vif->num_queues and attempt to access invalid queues.

This is the same cleanup algorithm as used in backend_disconnect and
added in commit b17075d5c198 ("xen-netback: fix race condition on XenBus
disconnect").

This is XSA-531

title: CVE-2026-99287 — In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xen-netback: Zero out sring pointers on unmap If xenvif_map_frontend_data_rings()
summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-netback: Zero out sring pointers on unmap

If xenvif_map_frontend_data_rings() fails when a ring is already mapped,
it unmaps them via xenvif_unmap_frontend_data_rings() which keeps the
ring pointers unchanged. xenvif_connect_data()'s cleanup path calls
xenvif_disconnect_queue() which in turn calls
xenvif_unmap_frontend_data_rings() again, which will attempt to unmap the
pointers a second time.

Zero out the ring pointers after they are unmapped to avoid this issue.

This is XSA-532

title: CVE-2026-125703 — A flaw was found in the GStreamer gst-plugins-bad MXF plugin
summary: A flaw was found in the GStreamer gst-plugins-bad MXF plugin. Insufficient bounds checks when parsing crafted VANC data can cause an out-of-bounds read in the demuxer, while an incorrect buffer size calculation when muxing multiple ancillary packets can cause an out-of-bounds write. Processing affected content may crash the application, resulting in a denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-125704 — A use-after-free flaw was found in GStreamer core buffer value deserialization
summary: A use-after-free flaw was found in GStreamer core buffer value deserialization. When crafted serialized buffer data contains an invalid character, an error path frees a mapped buffer before unmapping it. An application that parses untrusted caps or structure data could crash; a network-facing GStreamer Data Protocol receiver can process such data without user interaction. Further impact has not been established.

title: CVE-2026-124249 — http
summary:
http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an
already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the Domain and Path
attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy. A server
could therefore delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared
cookie jar, such as the one used by urllib's HTTPCookieProcessor. The fix
consults the cookie policy before an expired cookie may delete an existing
one, as required by RFC 6265 section 5.3.

From 10.1.0 until 11.0.9, 11.1.4, 11.2.4, 11.3.8, 11.4.8, 12.0.11, 12.1.2, 12.2.1, and 12.3.1, loadOptionsById_Transaction and getUserInfoByCredentialId_Transaction perform application-scoped WebAuthn lookups without constraining them to the requested tenant, and WebAuthN.signIn does not verify tenant membership. In a multi-tenant deployment using WebAuthn with a shared user pool, an ordinary user who possesses their own valid passkey in one tenant can submit its assertion to another tenant's sign-in endpoint in the same application and

title: CVE-2026-123804 — SuperTokens Core is an open source authentication server
summary: SuperTokens Core is an open source authentication server. From 7.0.0 until 11.0.9, 11.1.4, 11.2.4, 11.3.8, 11.4.8, 12.0.11, 12.1.2, 12.2.1, and 12.3.1, createNewSession can resolve a primary user before unlinkAccounts detaches a login method and then insert the session after unlink has enumerated and revoked the existing sessions. A user who controls the linked login method can exploit this race to retain a signed, database-backed, refreshable session as the former primary identity after that method is unlinked; the session persists until expiry or explicit revocation.
